description: Turn findings into an ordered remediation plan, with safe unified-diff patches where a fix is deterministic. Accepts findings or a path to scan.

deep.description: Deep scan when planning from a path

findings.description: Findings to plan for (alternative to path)

include_patches.description: Emit unified diffs for deterministic fixes (default true)

network.description: Allow dependency CVE lookup during the scan

path.description: File, directory, or archive (tar.gz/zip) to scan

tools.description: Scan subset when planning from a path

name: fix_plan
